question: What contradictory powers over Rāvaṇa does the goddess exercise?
premises: The goddess brings about the destruction of the ten-necked one.
The goddess grants boons to the ten-necked one.
Both destruction and boon-giving are attributed to her regarding the same figure.
inference: The goddess holds power both to grant boons to Rāvaṇa and to cause his destruction.
plain_english: She brings about the destruction of the ten-necked Rāvaṇa and also grants boons to him.
